name: Pirisudanol
summary: Pirisudanol, also known as pyrisuccideanol, is the succinic acid ester of pyridoxine (a form of vitamin B6) and of deanol (DMAE). It has been used in Europe in the treatment of mild cognitive impairment as well as fatigue and depression.

uses.text: It has been used in Europe in the treatment of mild cognitive impairment as well as fatigue and depression.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to be broken down in the body into pyridoxine (vitamin B6) and deanol. Deanol was proposed to raise acetylcholine levels in the brain, but this has not been clearly shown.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它在體內會分解成吡哆醇（維生素 B6）和 deanol。曾有人認為 deanol 能提高腦中的乙醯膽鹼濃度，但這一點並未獲得明確證實。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它在体内会分解成吡哆醇（维生素 B6）和 deanol。曾有人认为 deanol 能提高脑中的乙酰胆碱浓度，但这一点并未获得明确证实。

fact.en: Pirisudanol is two molecules tied together: vitamin B6 and deanol, joined through succinic acid, a compound the body makes in its own energy cycle.
fact.zh: Pirisudanol 是把兩個分子綁在一起：維生素 B6 和 deanol，透過琥珀酸相連，而琥珀酸是人體能量代謝循環中本來就會產生的物質。
fact.zhHans: Pirisudanol 是把两个分子绑在一起：维生素 B6 和 deanol，通过琥珀酸相连，而琥珀酸是人体能量代谢循环中本来就会产生的物质。
